pages.title: Widow Mine
pages.text: $(l)Health$(): 90$(br)No attack$(br)$(l)Speed$(): 3.94, on the ground$(br)$(l)Cost$(): 75 minerals, 25 vespene, 2 supply$(br)$(l)Build time$(): 21 s$(br2)$(o)StarCraft II numbers (LotV).$()

Burrow it (R): hidden in the ground, it fires a $(l)sentinel missile$() at the first foe within 5, on the ground or in the air — 125 (+35 to shields), 40 to the foes around — then rearms for 29 s. Unburrowed it has no attack. Detectors see it.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(l)Burrow$(): Hides under the ground: unseen without a detector; the lurker attacks only burrowed, the roach moves and heals
